derivation: The checkpoint is D2-237's result: a due deadline on a dependency-blocked occurrence expired evidence-only, so the deadline record is EXPIRED while the occurrence stays BLOCKED_DISPUTE and its active row still names the deadline. A fresh available CLOCK sample asks the consumer to restart. LIFE-014 makes an active occurrence's deadline_ids the names of every deadline activated for it whatever the record's status, and LIFE-019 admits the list when it equals the deadlines declared for the step, each with a retained record in any status. The checkpoint is admitted and the CLOCK sample recorded with no other change.
